function_ir.summary: One-time initialization of the special-effects / particle / track-surface material subsystem. It copies a track name string into a local buffer, opens and parses the special-effects config file (tokenized by section keywords trackvars / feedback / loose / reaction), building a linked list of name=value variable entries and a per-track include/feedback flag array. It then allocates and fills the two 108-byte-element arrays stored at this+0xC (track feedback effects, count at this+0x8) and this+0x14 (material-reaction effects, count at this+0x10), builds the cmaps.mas search path from the dword_5EC3D8/dword_5EC428 path globals, re-parses the file to instantiate reaction effects per track (MaterialShaderReactionEffectParser + TrackSurfaceMaterialLoader), registers strings, dispatches per-element-type enablement (sub_4CB120) via the switch table, zeroes and then fills the type-slot pointers at this+0x18..0x28, loads the scene track, runs a spatial grid query to seed dry/wet grip floats at this+0x30/0x34 (overridable from config tokens aidrygrip/aiwetgrip), and finally counts and allocates the particle-collision array at this+0x4 (count at this+0x0) populated with matching lptree nodes.
